section_suggestions.title: Key Relationships
section_suggestions.guidance: Narrative about the most significant relationships. Name each person with a link to their dossier. Explain the nature and significance of each relationship, not just that it exists.

curation.lead:
Eva Andersson-Dubin (born c. 1961) is a Swedish-born physician, former Miss Sweden 1980, and the wife of hedge fund manager Glenn Dubin. She dated Jeffrey Epstein throughout the 1980s before marrying Dubin in 1994, and the relationship with Epstein never ended — it simply changed form. The DOJ corpus documents at least 30 emails between Andersson-Dubin and Epstein spanning 2010 through February 2019, five months before Epstein's arrest. Flight logs record eight flights together between Palm Beach and the U.S. Virgin Islands (1998-2004). She appeared in Epstein's black book with six phone numbers. In 2009, one year after Epstein's Florida conviction for soliciting a minor, Andersson-Dubin wrote a letter to his Palm Beach probation officer declaring she was "100% comfortable with Jeffrey Epstein around her children" and describing him as "the godfather of my three children" — all three under eighteen at the time. Her inclusion as the seventh alternate successor trustee of The 1953 Trust (valued at $577 million as of August 2019) places her in Epstein's innermost fiduciary circle, alongside Darren Indyke, Richard Kahn, and Kathryn Ruemmler.

Andersson-Dubin served as a critical social and institutional bridge in the Epstein network. Through her directorship of the Dubin Breast Center at Mount Sinai, she hosted fundraising galas co-chaired by figures including Paul Tudor Jones, Steven Cohen, Howard Lutnick, David Shaw, and Kenneth Tropin — providing Epstein a legitimate social venue for accessing the hedge fund elite. She introduced David Fiszel to Epstein in December 2015, forwarding contact information from her Palm Beach neighbor; Fiszel went on to launch Honeycomb Asset Management with Epstein as a day-one LP investor committing over $60 million through Southern Trust Company. In her capacity as a board-certified physician (internal medicine), she also served as Epstein's trusted medical advisor, providing clinical guidance for Karyna Shuliak's mother's surgery in Belarus and referring plastic surgeons and massage services.

The most consequential documented finding concerns Andersson-Dubin's facilitation of Epstein's continued access to minor children after his 2008 conviction. On August 14, 2010, she emailed Epstein at Zorro Ranch: "come and visit next week. Celina will have 5 friends over" — Celina was approximately fifteen (EFTA02423721). DOJ documents record Epstein's driver Janusz transporting Celina to school, Epstein receiving invitations to Celina's birthday dinners, and Celina herself emailing Epstein for Soho House membership recommendation letters as late as 2018. Virginia Giuffre testified that she was directed by Epstein to have sexual encounters with Glenn Dubin while Eva was pregnant and sleeping in the next room. Eva testified for the defense at Ghislaine Maxwell's 2021 trial, denying any participation in sexual activity. No documented distancing from Epstein occurred at any point — gifts, muffins from Epstein's cook Valdson, and casual communications continued uninterrupted through May 2019, seven weeks before the arrest.
open_questions: What was the full scope of Eva Andersson-Dubin's knowledge of Epstein's sexual offending? Her 2009 probation letter vouched for his safety around children one year after his conviction, and her 2010 email invited him to visit when her 15-year-old daughter would have friends present. Did she genuinely believe the conviction represented an isolated incident, or did she possess information about ongoing conduct?

Why was Andersson-Dubin included as the seventh alternate successor trustee of The 1953 Trust — a $577 million estate vehicle — when the other listed trustees were Epstein's lawyers, estate executors, and professional advisors? What fiduciary obligation, if any, did this position carry, and was she aware of her inclusion?

What was the nature and extent of Eva's role at Dubin and Company (767 Fifth Avenue, later 55 Hudson Yards)? Her use of the eva@dubinandco.com email and Allison Yorke's coordination of Epstein-related logistics through the office suggest the firm served as an administrative interface between the Dubin and Epstein households.

To what degree did Eva's introductions — particularly the Fiszel-to-Epstein connection that produced the Honeycomb Asset Management investment — represent deliberate capital pipeline activity versus casual social networking? Did she understand that Epstein would invest tens of millions through Southern Trust Company as a result?

What motivated Eva's defense testimony at the Ghislaine Maxwell trial in 2021, and did she coordinate her testimony with Glenn Dubin or Epstein's legal team? Her voluntary appearance for the defense, rather than under subpoena for the prosecution, represents an active choice to support the accused.
curation.system_role: Andersson-Dubin represents the most documented case of a former romantic partner who transitioned into a sustained enabling role — providing Epstein with social legitimacy through philanthropy, direct introductions to hedge fund capital, medical services on demand, and continued access to her own minor children after his sex crime conviction.

sections.title: Romantic Origin and Social Persistence
sections.content:
Eva Andersson dated Jeffrey Epstein throughout the 1980s, a relationship that overlapped with her early medical career and her title as Miss Sweden 1980. She married Glenn Dubin in 1994, but the transition from romantic partner to family friend was seamless. Epstein became embedded in the Dubin household as a quasi-family member: the Dubin children referred to him as "Uncle Jeff," and the DOJ corpus documents Eva coordinating social events, medical referrals, staff logistics, and gift exchanges with Epstein on a near-daily basis from at least 2010 through May 2019.

The correspondence reveals a relationship that functioned more like extended family than social acquaintance. Eva and Epstein coordinated household staff across their respective properties in New York and Palm Beach — sharing drivers, discussing staff placements, and arranging for Dubin family members to stay at Epstein's Palm Beach staff house (EFTA02317917, EFTA02323534). Epstein's assistant Lesley Groff procured iPhones for Eva's daughter, arranged Christmas presents for the family, and delivered homemade muffins from Epstein's cook Valdson to Eva's apartment building doorman on a recurring basis. Eva's February 2019 email — "I ran out of muffins this morning and I do not know how I will survive without them" — captures the banality of a relationship that persisted undisturbed by a sex crime conviction, a sex offender registration, and mounting public scrutiny (EFTA02273734).

Critically, Eva demonstrated awareness that Epstein's legal status imposed restrictions on their contact. In an August 2016 email, she wrote: "He legally should not talk to me otherwise" (EFTA02300517) — suggesting she understood Epstein faced legal constraints, yet continued the relationship regardless. She also developed an independent relationship with Karyna Shuliak, Epstein's girlfriend, meeting her in building lobbies, checking on her mother's health, and exchanging massage service recommendations.

sections.title: Children and Post-Conviction Access
sections.content:
The most legally significant aspect of Eva Andersson-Dubin's relationship with Epstein is her documented facilitation of his continued access to minor children after his 2008 conviction for soliciting a minor. In 2009, she wrote a letter to Epstein's Palm Beach probation officer — obtained by ABC News through a public records request to the Palm Beach County State's Attorney — stating that Epstein was "the godfather of my three children" and that she was "100% comfortable with Jeffrey Epstein around her children." All three children were under eighteen at the time.

One year later, on August 14, 2010, Eva emailed Epstein while he was at Zorro Ranch in New Mexico: "come and visit next week. Celina will have 5 friends over" (EFTA02423721). Celina Dubin was approximately fifteen years old. The DOJ corpus documents an eight-year pattern of Epstein serving as a quasi-uncle figure with direct access to Celina: October 2010, Eva asked Epstein for a driver to pick Celina up from Randall's Island; December 2010, Epstein's driver Janusz drove Celina to school; March 2012, Eva invited Epstein to Celina's birthday dinner; May 2012, Eva offered Celina's old mattress to Epstein; April 2017, Eva forwarded Celina's graduation photos to Epstein; February 2018, Celina herself emailed Epstein and David Mitchell requesting Soho House membership recommendation letters (EFTA02533073).

This pattern extended through March 2019, when Allison Yorke at Dubin and Company (then at 55 Hudson Yards) coordinated sending something to Celina on Epstein's behalf. The documentary record thus establishes that Eva Andersson-Dubin actively maintained a channel through which a convicted sex offender had regular, unsupervised contact with her minor daughter — from approximately age twelve through early adulthood — and that she vouched for the safety of this arrangement in writing to law enforcement.

sections.title: Philanthropic Bridge and Hedge Fund Introductions
sections.content:
Eva Andersson-Dubin's directorship of the Dubin Breast Center at Mount Sinai served as the primary institutional venue through which Epstein accessed the New York hedge fund elite in a socially legitimate setting. The center's annual benefit galas were co-chaired by a roster of billionaire fund managers including Paul Tudor Jones, Steven Cohen, Howard Lutnick, David Shaw, and Kenneth Tropin — all names that appear in the Epstein correspondence. Sonia Jones, whom Epstein described as Eva's "best friend" (EFTA02454038), was honored at the 2013 gala and co-chaired events in 2011-2012. DOJ documents confirm Epstein attempted to gift the Dubin Center ten massage sessions (EFTA02473176), intertwining his preferred mode of transactional intimacy with Eva's medical philanthropy.

The most consequential introduction Eva facilitated was that of David Fiszel to Epstein in December 2015. Eva forwarded Fiszel's contact information from her Palm Beach neighbor Sarah Fiszel, noting "They are here until the 2nd. He lives down the road from me" (EFTA02347362). Eva also offered to provide Fiszel with Les Wexner's phone number. Within two months, Fiszel was in direct correspondence with Epstein, and by June 2016, Fiszel launched Honeycomb Asset Management LP with Epstein as a day-one investor, committing a documented $20 million initial wire through Southern Trust Company and eventually investing over $60 million across flagship and co-investment vehicles. The Fiszel introduction is the clearest documented instance of Eva serving as a capital pipeline: her social introduction directly resulted in one of Epstein's most significant post-conviction investment relationships.

Epstein reciprocated by offering staff placements to Eva — in July 2016, he proposed sending his driver Janusz and his wife to work at the Dubins' North Salem horse farm estate, though Eva replied they did not want to relocate from Florida (EFTA02345877). The exchange of domestic staff, medical referrals, and financial introductions constituted a mutual service economy that operated outside formal corporate structures.

sections.title: Medical Advisory and Personal Services
sections.content:
As a board-certified physician in internal medicine, Eva Andersson-Dubin provided Epstein with on-demand medical advisory services that extended well beyond casual recommendations. In September 2015, Epstein wrote to Eva that Karyna Shuliak's mother in Belarus needed "a myectomy with uterus and ovaries out," asking about advanced surgical techniques available in New York. Eva responded with a detailed clinical recommendation — "Myectomy with a total hysterectomy and oopherectomy" — and offered to discuss by phone (EFTA02489456). In April 2017, she referred Epstein to plastic surgeon Adam Kolker, forwarding his contact details with the endorsement "My recommendation would be Kolker" (EFTA02358293).

Eva also coordinated a broader medical care network that served the Epstein household. She arranged Karyna Shuliak's care through Sonia Jones's physician "Pete" for Epstein's back pain treatment. In January 2018, Eva and Karyna exchanged recommendations for Chinese massage services at "Graceful Services" — "I like Angela and Shelly. Jeffrey likes Charlie, but he is too strong for me" (EFTA02323949). The November 2015 invitation forwarded by Karyna to Epstein for the Dubin Breast Center benefit gala (EFTA02671427) demonstrates how Eva's medical philanthropy, her personal medical practice, and Epstein's social circle operated as a single integrated network.

This medical advisory role gave Eva a degree of intimate access to Epstein's personal life that few non-staff members possessed. She knew the health status of his girlfriend's family members, his physical complaints, his aesthetic preferences, and his daily routines. It is a pattern consistent with a former partner who never fully exited the relationship but instead redirected its functional components — from romance to domestic management, medical triage, and social facilitation.

sections.title: Trust Succession and Inner Circle Position
sections.content:
Eva Andersson-Dubin's structural importance to the Epstein network is confirmed by her inclusion in the succession chain of The 1953 Trust, Epstein's primary estate vehicle valued at $577 million as of August 8, 2019. She is listed as the seventh alternate successor trustee, following Darren Indyke, Richard Kahn, Boris Nikolic, Barnaby Marsh, Anthony Barrett, Kathryn Ruemmler, David Mitchell, and Steve Hanson. The other names on this list are Epstein's attorneys, estate executors, science advisors, and household managers — placing Eva in the company of people who controlled or administered Epstein's legal and financial affairs, not casual social contacts.

Her co-occurrence with Epstein across eight LMSBAND files and over one thousand DugganUSA document hits further confirms that Andersson-Dubin was among the most referenced individuals in the entire Epstein documentary record. This documentary footprint exceeds that of many figures who had direct financial or legal relationships with Epstein. The Dubin and Company office at 767 Fifth Avenue (the same building as Wachtell Lipton) served as a logistics hub for Epstein-related gift and communication flows, with Allison Yorke coordinating deliveries between Epstein's staff and Eva. Eva's email address — eva@dubinandco.com — confirms she was formally part of Glenn Dubin's business organization, not merely a social contact communicating through personal channels.

Virginia Giuffre's testimony that Epstein directed her to have sexual encounters with Glenn Dubin while Eva was pregnant and sleeping in the next room represents a direct allegation of the Dubin household as a site of trafficking-related activity. Eva testified for the defense at Ghislaine Maxwell's 2021 trial, denying any participation in or knowledge of sexual activity. The tension between this denial, the probation letter vouching for Epstein's safety around children, and the documented pattern of facilitating Epstein's access to her minor daughter constitutes the central unresolved question of this dossier.

Combined with 1000+ DugganUSA hits and the medical care coordination for Karyna Shuliak, Eva Dubin was one of Epsteins most important but under-investigated social nodes.
